description: Dept. of Local Government - Eastern Province - By-laws of Verugal, Koralaipattu, Korabipattu - North Manmunai Pattu and Manmunai South  Eruvilpattu
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves the publication of new by-laws (local regulations) for the Verugal Pradeshiya Sabha, covering advertising, hotels, bakeries, and various businesses. It establishes regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements under the Pradeshiya Sabha Act, which falls under Legal/Regulatory matters (Type 5) rather than government personnel/structure changes or other specialized categories.
